t: Flomasta MDPE push-fit straight 25mm coupler allows fast, secure and demountable connections in MDPE pipe systems. Provides reliable, leak-free seals and ideal for use in poly pipe systems. Features anti-debris seal that protects the internal mechanism from blockages. Fits MDPE PE80 pipe, compatible with standard mains systems and can be used above or below ground. 16 bar rated for handling tough pressure demands.
b: Suitable for Domestic Cold Water Systems
